verdict.rationale: YYLO exposes agent and task state signals: a "watch receipt" with state, exit code and log bytes, a `WORKING` task status after `task start`, Ledger records holding status and blockers, and read-only local views. However, the evidence shows these mainly as completion receipts and status records, not as live streaming of what an agent is doing as it runs. Missing for 10: documented real-time agent activity or log streaming, a live status dashboard or watch command description, and independent hands-on corroboration.
